subject: POC success criteria & KPI alignment (Atlas Payments)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@atlas-payments.com>, Sally Nguyen <sally.nguyen@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: POC success criteria & KPI alignment (Atlas Payments)

Hi Ethan / Sally — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed plan so we can lock down the POC scope and owners.

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary use case: real-time payment routing assistant for support agents (~512 token prompts, mix of short contexts).
- Key constraints: sub-500ms p95 latency during normal traffic, predictable unit cost, and high intent/answer accuracy for routing decisions.

Proposed success criteria / KPIs (draft)
- Latency: p50 < 200ms, p95 < 500ms for 512-token requests (measured end-to-end from API surface).
- Throughput: sustained 50 req/s with <10% error rate; burst to 150 req/s for short windows.
- Cost: target effective cost <= $0.003 per token when amortized over typical traffic patterns (we'll model with your traffic profile).
- Quality: intent match >= 95% on the evaluation set (we'll use your sample dataset + synthetic variations).

Evaluation plan
- Week 0 (this week): share sample dataset & access requirements.
- Week 1: integration + smoke tests (connect API, run basic inference, validate latency/throughput in small load).
- Week 2: scale testing + quality evals (load shapes, regression tests, quality scoring vs. your labels).
- Deliverable: POC report with measured KPIs, cost model, and recommended config (batching/quantization/routing).

Owners / roles
- Jordan Blake (sales lead / overall POC coordinator) — scheduling, contract questions, final deliverable sign-off.
- Laura Bennett (POC owner / customer success) — technical onboarding, evaluation harness, quality scoring.
- Marcus Lin (SRE / performance) — load testing, perf tuning, infra config.
- Priyom Das (Solutions Engineer) — model/config recommendations and on-call for integration.
- Monica Patel (Security) — data handling, encryption, and compliance checks.

Next steps
1) Ethan: share 1-2 sample transcripts and the ground-truth routing labels by end of week (ideally by 2026-02-20).
2) Monica / Atlas security: confirm any additional onboarding requirements (VPN, IP allowlist, KMS) so we can scope the private connectivity option.
3) Laura & Marcus: schedule a 30m kickoff for Mon 2026-02-22 to kick off integration.
4) Jordan: we'll send the POC plan + brief SOW (attached) for signature.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (POC plan & SOW), atlas-eval-dataset.csv (placeholder sample set)

Thanks — feel free to edit the acceptance criteria if anything should be stricter/looser.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & KPI alignment (Atlas Payments)

Thanks Jordan — this looks good. A couple of clarifications / minor tweaks from the CS side: 

- Quality metric: we'll calculate intent match and top-1 routing accuracy. Let's define "intent match >= 95%" as "top-1 routing matches ground truth on >=95% of evaluation examples". We'll also report top-3 accuracy.
- Latency measurement: we'll report both client-observed (end-to-end including network) and server-side (inference only) p50/p95 to isolate network vs infra.
- Cost model: we'll deliver a per-scenario estimate (baseline traffic and peak). If you can share a 48-hour traffic sample, Marcus can run an accurate cost projection.

Owners + specific tasks: 
- Laura: set up evaluation harness (Data ingestion, scoring scripts). Due: 2026-02-24.
- Marcus: build load profiles and smoke test infra. Due: 2026-02-24.
- Priyom: recommend model/quantization config after initial smoke. Due: 2026-02-25.
- Monica: confirm encryption at-rest/in-transit and any audit log requirements. Due: 2026-02-20.

Ethan — can you confirm you can share the sample transcripts and a short traffic dump by 2026-02-20? If yes, we'll lock the kickoff for Mon 2026-02-22 10:00 PT.

-Laura

Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@atlas-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sally Nguyen <sally.nguyen@atlas-payments.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & KPI alignment (Atlas Payments)

Jordan / Laura — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- We'll provide a sanitized 48-hour traffic dump and ~1k labeled transcripts by EOD 2026-02-20.
- The timeline works for us; kickoff on Mon 2026-02-22 at 10:00 PT is fine.
- Regarding security: we need encryption at-rest + in-transit, and we have a KMS preference (AWS KMS). Monica, happy to connect on details.
- One question on monitoring: can you provide a Grafana dashboard or similar during the POC that reports latency percentiles, request volume, error rates, and cost burn? That's important for our ops team.

On the SLA note — this POC is mainly to validate economics and quality. We'll discuss production SLA once we complete the POC.

Thanks,
Ethan Ross
Head of Integrations | Atlas Payments
ethan.ross@atlas-payments.com

Subject: Re: POC success criteria & KPI alignment (Atlas Payments)

Thanks Ethan — great, appreciate the quick turnaround.

Action items (confirming)
- Atlas: sample data + 48-hour traffic dump by 2026-02-20 (noted).
- Monica: we'll follow up re: KMS requirements; Monica will propose options for in-transit / at-rest encryption and share onboarding doc.
- Redwood: Laura + Marcus to run evaluation harness and circulate preliminary KPI dashboard during week 2. We'll share a Grafana link for live monitoring.

I'll book the Mon 10:00 PT kickoff and send a calendar invite + agenda. If anything changes on your side before then, let me know.

Jordan
